About the job
This is a remote position. We are hiring a Fullstack Software Engineer with deep experience building AI-powered products in production. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of fullstack engineering, AI systems design, and product thinking. You will not simply integrate APIs. You will architect multi-agent systems, design RAG pipelines, and take AI features from concept to production with full accountability for system reliability, performance, and cost.
You will work across the entire stack (frontend, backend, data, and cloud infrastructure) and operate as a product-minded engineer who drives outcomes, not just ships code. You will collaborate directly with Product Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous requirements into production-ready solutions.
If you thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about outcomes over output, and want to shape how AI is built into real products, this role is for you.

Responsibilities
Fullstack Product Development
Own features end-to-end: from UI (React/Next.js) through API design (Node.js/NestJS) to cloud deployment.
Partner with Product Owners and Subject Matter Experts to translate requirements into shipped solutions.
Contribute product ideas that improve usability, performance, and business impact.
AI Engineering and Systems Design
Design and build multi-agentic systems where autonomous AI agents collaborate to solve complex, real-world task
Architect and implement RAG pipelines using vector databases and LLM orchestration frameworks.
Take AI-powered features from prototype to production, owning model serving, latency optimization, cost management, and system reliability.
Work with AI SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent tools to build and orchestrate AI workflows.
Cloud Infrastructure and Deployment
Design, deploy, and manage scalable systems on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Apply cloud-agnostic thinking: understand core concepts regardless of provider.

Requirements
Minimum Qualifications:
3-5+ years of professional experience building production applications with React/Next.js, Node.js/NestJS, and PostgreSQL.
Hands-on experience with at least one of: AI SDK (Vercel), LangGraph/LangChain, or CrewAI.
Proven track record designing, orchestrating, and deploying multi-agent AI systems in production.
Working experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar) and RAG pipeline design.
Strong understanding of AI deployment and system design: model serving, latency optimization, cost management, and production reliability.
Experience with prompt engineering, model selection, and evaluation.
Solid understanding of cloud concepts and services across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Experience deploying and managing production workloads in at least one major cloud platform.

About the job
Overview

Position Summary We are seeking an AI Implementation Support professional to help deploy, maintain, and optimize AI-powered solutions across the organization. This hands-on role is ideal for a full-stack developer with experience implementing AI automation tools, integrating AI into business processes, and supporting production deployments. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to accelerate AI adoption and improve operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Implement, deploy, and support AI-powered applications and automation workflows.
Develop and maintain full-stack applications that integrate with leading AI platforms.
Configure, test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI solutions for business users.
Collaborate with business and IT teams to identify automation opportunities and implement AI-driven solutions.
Maintain documentation and provide technical support for AI implementations.

Minimum Requirements:

Minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience with AI automation or AI implementation.
Strong experience as a Full-Stack Developer.
Proficiency with AI development tools including Claude, Codex, Copilot, and other modern AI platforms.
Experience deploying applications into production environments.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Requirements:

Experience integrating AI with enterprise systems and APIs.
Familiarity with cloud deployment platforms, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development frameworks.
Passion for leveraging AI to improve business operations and productivity.
